summary: Aspire Biopharma Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing the adjournment of its shareholder meeting on June 9, 2026 due to lack of quorum. The meeting was rescheduled to June 16, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. via the same link. This is a routine procedural filing regarding meeting logistics and does not reflect a special situation such as a merger, acquisition, activist campaign, or management change. No financial terms, board recommendations, or strategic actions are provided. The filing contains no substantive event indicating a special situation.
